final: SELECT SUM(state_total), AVG(invoice_count) FROM (SELECT c.State, SUM(i.Total) AS state_total, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State)
